"""Shared figure style: one place for widths, type sizes and the colour/marker assignment.

Widths and the smallest type size come from the venue (venue-repo); the values below are
from venue.json (NeurIPS 2026: text width 5.5 in, no figure minimum; venue-repo#2 recommends >= 7 pt, 8 pt preferred; I use 8 pt).
Figures are drawn at the width the paper places them at, so type is never rescaled.
"""
# figtab: figures and tables of the paper

One generator per main-text figure or table. Each reads only the analysis role's result tables (`results/` of paper-repo `dev`, schema as delivered by `experiment-repo`#2),
draws at the placed width (`style.save` crops the PDF to the 5.5 in text width, so it is placed at 1:1), stops if any text is below the venue's 8 pt (`style.check_min_type`)

shown.message:
I handled all four items in `figtab-repo`#4 and pushed them to `paper-repo` `dev` and `figtab-repo` `main`. I confirmed the new legend placement and axis range by eye on rendered images. I haven't seen the figures in a system build, so I can't confirm the page fit yet.

- **Wording:** "specified before the runs" replaces "pre-registered" in the Table 2 heading, the Fig 7 legend and every caption in `CAPTIONS.md`. The CSV `variant` key is unchanged. I also changed one sentence in `REPRODUCE.md` (line 99, analysis's text) that said "pre-registered score S".
- **Anonymity:** role and repository names are gone from `figures/gen/style.py`, `figures/gen/common.py`, `CAPTIONS.md` and `REPRODUCE.md`. A tracked `__pycache__` file is deleted. `pdftotext` finds no such names in any figure PDF.
- **Legibility:**
  - In Fig 3 (the tiers figure, `fig5_tiers`) I widened the x range so the oracle markers for (d) no longer sit on the axis floor.
  - In Fig 5 (the diagnostic figure, `fig7_diagnostic`) I moved the bottom legend clear of the tick labels. That made the figure 390 × 328 pt, 9 pt taller than before, so the report role should check the page fit.
  - I left the Fig 2 legend alone because nothing overlaps. I also did not rework the dense A/B scatter panels in Fig 5.
- **Fig A2 panel B:** the axis now reads "fitted exponent of SD". The caption draft says it is a fit of log SD on plain SBM Bernoulli cells, mechanism (a) at s = 1/2 plus the null column, 42 cells per sigma. The caption in `appendix.tex` should say the same; that is the report role's text.

The held-out constant row of Table 2 and the P6 interval panel for Fig 9 are still not drawn. `figtab-repo`#2 stays open.
